transcript: Speaker A: Vani, ye jo hum galat English bolte hain, usse Hindi mein kya bolte hain? Jaise log bolte hain "Very unique". [Vani, what do we call the incorrect English we speak in Hindi? Like people say "Very unique".] Speaker B: Uska matlab hota hai ekdam sabse alag. Lekin unique ka matlab hi alag hota hai, isliye "very" mat lagao. [It means completely different. But unique itself means different, so don't use "very".] Speaker A: Accha, aur log jo bolte hain "Blunder mistake"? [Okay, and what about when people say "Blunder mistake"?] Speaker B: Hindi mein bolo bahut badi galti. Par English mein sirf "blunder" bolo, "mistake" lagana galat hai. [In Hindi, say a very big mistake. But in English, just say "blunder", adding "mistake" is wrong.] Speaker A: Oho! Aur jab sab bolte hain "Return back"? [Oh! And when everyone says "Return back"?] Speaker B: Matlab wapas aana. Par English mein sirf "return" bolo, "back" mat lagao. [It means to come back. But in English, just say "return", don't use "back".] Speaker A: Teri to! Hum roz aisi galat English bolte hain. [Oh my! We speak such incorrect English every day.] Speaker B: Isiliye to Speakeasy app pe main hoon na. Roz bas 15 minute akele mein practice karo aur apni galat English ko sahi karo. [That's why I am on the Speakeasy app. Just practice for 15 minutes daily in private and correct your incorrect English.] Speaker A: Ab doston ke samne beizzat nahi hogi. Speakeasy app abhi download karta hoon. [Now I won't be embarrassed in front of friends. I'll download the Speakeasy app right now.] Speaker C: Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Vani. Ye Jo Ham Galat English Bolte Hain... Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with Speakeasy. Install Now. [Vani. The incorrect English we speak... Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with Speakeasy. Install Now.]
summary: A paragliding man learns to correct common English redundancies from his AI companion, Vani. She advises him to practice daily on the Speakeasy app to avoid social embarrassment. The ad ends with a call to download the app for fluent English.
